project: STAR INK — Ethereal Fine-Art Fairy Blueprint
philosophy: Haute-Couture Fashion Illustration & Organic Linework (Zero ClipArt)

master_structure.goal: Generate a graceful, haute-couture fine-line fairy illustration composed of wispy, organic white lines on a pure black background. Must retain high-fashion elegance and slender proportions.

secondary: zero clipart, zero cartoon, zero flat vector

main_subject.physique: ultra-slender, elongated haute-couture fashion model proportions
main_subject.pose: graceful arching back, floating en pointe in profile, holding a delicate thin wand pointed upwards at a 45-degree angle
main_subject.wings: intricate translucent dragonfly-inspired wings drawn with delicate wispy white lines
main_subject.hair: elegant messy bun with delicate flyaway hair strands
main_subject.dress: feather-light, wispy layered fringe dress composed of fine organic stroke lines

lighting.effects: no light bulbs, no magic sparkles, no neon, no heavy fill
